caseName: Environmental Protection Agency v. Duquesne Light Co.
caseNameFull: Environmental Protection Agency v. Duquesne Light Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 3d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Union Electric Co. v. EPA, ante, p. 246.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
